question.nlq: Could you tell me how many orders I have placed, the total number of items across those orders, and the number of distinct product colors I have purchased?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The user is the customer with customer_id = 1 (Carmen Treutel).
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o WHERE o.customer_id = 1) AS order_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = 1) AS total_items,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_color)
   FROM Order_Items oi
   JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
   JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
   WHERE o.customer_id = 1) AS distinct_colors;
